  • Curiosidade para entender os desafios dos clientes.

  • Proatividade para executar e sugerir melhorias.

title: Senior Human Resources Recruiter
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Human Resources Recruiter em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Regional Talent Acquisition Partner – Freelance

Location: Remote, Brazil


Contract Type : Independent Contractor (PJ setup required)


About Thoth AI At Thoth AI, we are building the data infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI. From complex LLMs to cutting-edge embodied AI, our global team delivers the high-quality, multimodal data that makes continuous AI innovation possible.

We are a fast-moving, globally distributed team, and we are looking for passionate builders to join our journey.


The Role : We are expanding our global footprint and looking for an agile Regional Talent Acquisition Specialist. You won't just be filling requisitions; you will be the architect of our regional talent strategy. Working seamlessly with our global HQ and cross-border teams, you will have the autonomy to design creative sourcing strategies, build robust talent communities, and directly impact the delivery of high-profile AI projects.


What You Will Do

  • Pioneer Creative Sourcing: Go beyond traditional job boards. You will tap into the gig economy, localized social media networks, and specialized tech communities to uncover hidden talent.
  • Build the Future Workforce: Curate and nurture dynamic talent pools across various AI data project types, ensuring we can deploy top-tier talent swiftly as new technologies emerge.
  • Drive Global Synergy: Collaborate daily with our diverse teams across Beijing, Southeast Asia, and beyond. You will be the LATAM market expert, providing critical market intelligence and cost benchmarking to shape our global pricing and project strategies.
  • Innovate Recruitment: Bring your ideas to the table. We encourage experimentation with new sourcing tools, AI-assisted recruitment workflows, and grassroots vendor networking.


Who You Are

  • Experienced in full-cycle recruitment within the Tech, AI, or dynamic BPO sectors across Latin America.
  • A strategic thinker who thrives in a fully remote, asynchronous, and global work environment.
  • Bilingual in English and Portuguese (Spanish is a strong plus).
  • Established as an Independent Contractor with a registered PJ entity in Brazil.
  • Passionate about the AI industry and eager to grow within a disruptive, tech-forward culture.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)

Location: Remote

Experience: 7+ Years


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) to join a high-performing engineering team focused on delivering exceptional customer experiences and building scalable software solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex technical challenges, contribute to strategic initiatives, and collaborate with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will serve as both a hands-on developer and technical leader, helping drive engineering excellence, mentoring team members, and contributing to the evolution of the platform and architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, high-quality software solutions.
  • Build and enhance customer-facing web applications and services.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver business-critical features.
  • Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to architectural decisions.
  • Review code and provide constructive feedback to peers.
  • Mentor engineers through collaboration, pair programming, and knowledge sharing.
  • Deploy, monitor, and support applications in production environments.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt modern technologies and engineering best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and/or Kotlin.
  • Experience working in Ruby on Rails environments.
  • Expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong experience with React and related front-end technologies.
  • Experience with Node.js and modern development tooling.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, version control systems, and deployment processes.
  • Understanding of GraphQL, event-driven architectures, and database design concepts.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming platforms.
  • Experience working with Elixir.
  • Experience decomposing monolithic applications into microservices.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.
  • Experience building scalable applications in cloud environments.

Technical Environment

  • Java
  • Kotlin
  • TypeScript
  • React
  • GraphQL
  • Kafka
  • AWS Lambda
  • PostgreSQL
  • DynamoDB
  • Ruby on Rails
  • Elixir

title: Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)
  • Diagnose and resolve system issues across hardware and software layers
  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)
  • Ensure minimal disruption to live operations during implementation

Training & Change Management

  • Support operational teams in adopting new technologies
  • Provide training and documentation for system usage and best practices

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Experience in project management (PMP or equivalent is a plus)
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting (Python or similar)
  • Experience with data analysis and performance optimization
  • Background in industrial engineering, robotics, or logistics systems
  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

title: Talent Acquisitions Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisitions Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

This is a full time remote role for a Talent Acquisitions Specialist. The Talent Acquisitions Specialist will be responsible for managing the full recruitment cycle, sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, coordinating with hiring managers, and onboarding new employees. Additional tasks include maintaining employee records, providing onboarding administrative support, and supporting the development and implementation of HR initiatives. 


The position follows U.S. Eastern Time business hours, generally Monday through Friday. Working hours will vary slightly throughout the year due to business needs but will typically align with approximately 9:00 AM–6:00 PM EST.


Qualifications

  • C1 or C2 level of English. Candidates below C1 level will not be considered . 
  • 3-8 years experience in recruitment, sourcing candidates, and conducting interviews
  • Skills in employee relations, HR policies, and labor law compliance
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills
  • The ability to maintain clear, consistent communication with hiring managers and internal stakeholders regarding the status of active searches, candidate pipelines, timelines, and next steps.
  • Proficiency in HR software and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)
  • Ability to manage multiple sourcing channels simultaneously, including alternative platforms and outreach methods beyond traditional job boards.
  • Analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field required


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment:

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.


How to Apply:

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

title: Senior Software Engineer (Go)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Go) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Together with the Zoolatech team, our partner, a leading construction management company, is at the forefront of developing a cloud-based software solution. This innovative platform is instrumental in the successful completion of major projects including skyscrapers, hospitals, data centers, stadiums, and schools. It streamlines the management of finances, quality, teams, and risks, making these processes transparent, convenient, and regulation-compliant. Our partner is not only an expert in construction management but also a significant technology innovator, actively developing web and mobile solutions.


Currently Directory business unit owns user identity and access management across their entire platform ecosystem. They've just launched a brand-new Go-based service into closed beta — a ground-up rebuild of how users and companies are managed across the platform. It's live, but not yet actively used. title: Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)
  • Diagnose and resolve system issues across hardware and software layers
  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)
  • Ensure minimal disruption to live operations during implementation

Training & Change Management

  • Support operational teams in adopting new technologies
  • Provide training and documentation for system usage and best practices

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Experience in project management (PMP or equivalent is a plus)
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting (Python or similar)
  • Experience with data analysis and performance optimization
  • Background in industrial engineering, robotics, or logistics systems
  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

description:

Seeking a freelance project that will allow you to work from home while making a difference in the world of technology? If you are someone who is passionate and enjoys staying ahead of the tech curve this part-time remote project with flexible working hours might be what you are looking for!


A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Ads Assessor:

  • In this role, you will be reviewing online advertisements by rating them on their relevance to the search terms used as well as providing feedback on their language and cultural relevance in order to improve their content, quality, and layout
  • Your ultimate goal will be to contribute towards making internet search and online advertising more relevant and interesting for millions of users, including yourself.



Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading online advertising platforms while being a part of a supportive community that offers:

  • Access to complimentary mental health support benefits like free EAP and Mindfulness Apps.
  • Dedicated, responsive well-being team proactively offering well-being education each month, as well as quarterly initiatives.



TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.


Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.


Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills, with full professional proficiency in English and Geman
  • Having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Brazil
  • Active use of Gmail, Google+, and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Daily access to a broadband internet connection, a smartphone (Android 4.1, iOS 8 or higher), and a personal computer with antivirus software to work on. You’ll also need a
  • Barcode Scanner application to be installed on your smartphone to complete certain tasks.
  • English CV
  • This is an explicit human evaluation role. Live task rating requires authentic human judgment, perspective, and evaluation


The estimated hourly earnings for this role is 6 USD. Payment is based on completed tasks, with the potential for higher earnings based on productivity.


Assessment

In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take a language assessment and an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Don’t worry, our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience!


Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. title: Especialista Modern Work - Intune
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista Modern Work - Intune em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a vaga A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Um(a) profissional experiente em Microsoft Intune para atuar com clientes corporativos, apoiando a gestão moderna de dispositivos e aplicações em ambientes diversos (Windows, iOS, Android e macOS). O papel envolve arquitetura, implementação e evolução de soluções de endpoint management, segurança e identidade, com foco em ambientes híbridos e cloud, garantindo escalabilidade, compliance e excelência operacional.


Principais atuações:

  • Liderar estratégias de gerenciamento unificado de endpoints (UEM) utilizando Microsoft Intune e Configuration Manager (SCCM) .
  • Projetar, implementar e sustentar soluções de gerenciamento para múltiplas plataformas:
  • Windows (desktop e server)
  • Android (Enterprise – Work Profile, Fully Managed, Dedicated)
  • iOS / iPadOS
  • macOS
  • Planejar e executar cenários de co-gerenciamento (co-management) entre SCCM e Intune, incluindo workload transition.
  • Conduzir projetos de migração de ambientes legados (SCCM standalone, GPOs, MDMs de terceiros) para o Intune.



Requisitos necessários:

  • Inglês avançado para conversação.
  • Sólida experiência com Microsoft Intune em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.
  • Forte experiência com SCCM (Configuration Manager) :
  • Application Deployment
  • OSD (Task Sequences)
  • Software Updates / Patch Management
  • Experiência comprovada com Android, iOS/iPadOS e macOS no contexto de MDM/MAM.
  • Conhecimento avançado em co-management e ambientes híbridos .
  • Experiência com Microsoft Entra ID, Acesso Condicional e identidade híbrida .
  • Vivência com Autopilot, Autopatch e modernização de gerenciamento .
  • Experiência com empacotamento de aplicações (Win32, MSI, scripts) .
  • Forte capacidade de troubleshooting e análise de logs .
  • Experiência com automação (PowerShell / Graph API) .
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de certificados (PKI) .



Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) e Windows 365 .
  • Conhecimento em Zero Trust .
  • Certificações Microsoft (MD-102, MS-102, AZ-900, etc.).


**Vaga Híbrida - (90% H.O, 10% com possibilidades de viagens nível Brasil)



O que oferecemos?

Contratação CLT

Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

Auxílio creche;

Convênio com Farmácia;

Cartão GoodCard;

Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

Gympass



  • O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD). Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas.

title: Talent Acquisitions Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisitions Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

This is a full time remote role for a Talent Acquisitions Specialist. The Talent Acquisitions Specialist will be responsible for managing the full recruitment cycle, sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, coordinating with hiring managers, and onboarding new employees. Additional tasks include maintaining employee records, providing onboarding administrative support, and supporting the development and implementation of HR initiatives. 


The position follows U.S. Eastern Time business hours, generally Monday through Friday. Working hours will vary slightly throughout the year due to business needs but will typically align with approximately 9:00 AM–6:00 PM EST.


Qualifications

  • C1 or C2 level of English. Candidates below C1 level will not be considered . 
  • 3-8 years experience in recruitment, sourcing candidates, and conducting interviews
  • Skills in employee relations, HR policies, and labor law compliance
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills
  • The ability to maintain clear, consistent communication with hiring managers and internal stakeholders regarding the status of active searches, candidate pipelines, timelines, and next steps.
  • Proficiency in HR software and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)
  • Ability to manage multiple sourcing channels simultaneously, including alternative platforms and outreach methods beyond traditional job boards.
  • Analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field required

Preferred

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Java Spring experience. This is not a standard backend role — it's designed for engineers who are technically broad, adaptable, and comfortable operating across development, operations, and cloud environments.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and maintain backend solutions using Java Spring / Spring Boot

  • Maintain and troubleshoot Jenkins pipelines and GitLab CI/CD workflows

  • Strong Java Spring / Spring Boot experience
  • Practical knowledge of Kubernetes (clusters, pods, deployments, troubleshooting)
  • Familiarity with AWS services: EKS, IAM, Parameter Store, Secrets Manager, Security Groups
  • Experience with Jenkins pipelines and GitLab CI/CD
  • Basic understanding of Terraform and IaC concepts
  • Scripting skills in Python or equivalent
  • Resilience and adaptability in dynamic, fast-changing environments

Good to have

  • Previous experience in the financial services industry
  • Background in mixed roles combining development and operational tasks

What we offer:

  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
  • Various benefits include flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

description:

The work ahead is substantial: migrating data and business logic out of a Ruby monolith, building new features in parallel, and accelerating the service toward full production ownership. Now we are looking for reinforcement for the team to develop the new service and help with the migration from the legacy platform.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain backend services in Go, implementing event-driven systems governed by CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Drive migration of business logic and data from the Ruby legacy monolith into the new Go service
  • Contribute to the new service while it moves from closed beta toward becoming authoritative — building ongoing features in parallel with migration
  • Develop and extend GraphQL Federation schemas that power the federated API gateway
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and UX to design and build solutions that address user and company management challenges
  • Use a systems engineering approach to make technical design decisions that improve scalability, performance, and reliability
  • Write highly performant code that supports a distributed, multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  • Conduct code reviews, provide mentorship, and actively drive engineering excellence across the team
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Skills Required

  • 5+ years in Software Engineering across full-stack distributed applications
  • 3+ years of hands-on Go in production microservices
  • Experience with CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Experience with Kafka or similar distributed event streaming platforms
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, including data modeling and query optimization
  • Familiarity with GraphQL, including schema design
  • Working knowledge of React and TypeScript for frontend contributions
  • Comfort working across the full development lifecycle: design, testing, staging, deployment, monitoring
  • Strong communication skills — ability to collaborate across US and international time zones
  • US time zone or compatible overlap (EST/CST);

Would be a huge plus:

  • Experience with Ruby/Rails systems, including incremental refactoring and modernization


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)


This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.


To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.


Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment

  • Advise on the right path : You assess where each ISV is and recommend the program or plan that moves them forward, from IP Co-sell eligibility to Certified Software status to new channels.
  • Drive adoption into revenue : You implement the work that converts a live listing into transactions: CRM integration, Crossbeam setup, sales comp parity, and Microsoft incentives.
  • Challenge the customer : When results aren't there, you challenge their structure and bring them a revised plan rather than a status update.
  • Navigating the Microsoft Field : You connect customers to the right AEs and PDMs and build the co-sell motion that moves deals.
  • Compounding with AI : AI is part of your daily workflow across research, QBR prep, and pipeline. This isn't a perk we offer, it's how we operate.


What We're Looking For

  • +4 years in sales at a B2B tech company. Quota-carrying, with a track record of growing accounts. CSM or account management background is a plus, not a substitute.
  • You think in revenue. Adoption is the means, not the metric.
  • English fluent. You present to Customer or Microsoft stakeholders in English without prep.
  • Daily, instinctive use of AI tools.
  • Comfortable being the one who tells a customer their approach isn't working — and what to do instead.
  • You manage 30+ accounts without dropping the ball.


What You Get

  • Unlimited PTO.
  • AI-first culture across the business.
  • Direct access to Microsoft teams and the partner ecosystem most companies spend years trying to reach.
  • Real ownership of a revenue book, measured in outcomes not activity.
  • Path to senior measured in quarters, not years.
  • Global team in more than 12 countries with a strong culture.


About WeTransact

Most companies in our space raise tens of millions and burn it chasing this market. We bootstrapped, turned a profit, and built the software that 500+ companies now use to sell through Microsoft. Titles don't matter here. Accountability does, and so does winning as a team.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-Response Creative Strategist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us

Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.

We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.

We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.


The role

We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.

You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.

You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.


What we’re looking for

We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.

You should have:

  • 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook
  • A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic
  • Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts
  • The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative
  • Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.


What we offer

Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.

You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.

This is a fully remote position.


One thing worth knowing

There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.

title: Talent Acquisitions Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisitions Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

This is a full time remote role for a Talent Acquisitions Specialist. The Talent Acquisitions Specialist will be responsible for managing the full recruitment cycle, sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, coordinating with hiring managers, and onboarding new employees. Additional tasks include maintaining employee records, providing onboarding administrative support, and supporting the development and implementation of HR initiatives. 


The position follows U.S. Eastern Time business hours, generally Monday through Friday. Working hours will vary slightly throughout the year due to business needs but will typically align with approximately 9:00 AM–6:00 PM EST.


Qualifications

  • C1 or C2 level of English. Candidates below C1 level will not be considered . 
  • 3-8 years experience in recruitment, sourcing candidates, and conducting interviews
  • Skills in employee relations, HR policies, and labor law compliance
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills
  • The ability to maintain clear, consistent communication with hiring managers and internal stakeholders regarding the status of active searches, candidate pipelines, timelines, and next steps.
  • Proficiency in HR software and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)
  • Ability to manage multiple sourcing channels simultaneously, including alternative platforms and outreach methods beyond traditional job boards.
  • Analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field required


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment:

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.


How to Apply:

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

title: Senior Machine Learning Architect (Databricks) - Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Machine Learning Architect (Databricks) - Remote em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?


  • 8+ years of experience in Data, AI, or Machine Learning Engineering roles;
  • 3+ years of experience designing ML platforms or AI architecture at scale;
  • Strong hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, Python, and SQL;
  • Proficient understanding of MLOps, ML lifecycle management, distributed ML systems, feature engineering, and model deployment patterns;
  • Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, and Lakehouse architecture;
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP);
  • Proven ability to deploy ML models into production environments;
  • Strong knowledge of data architecture and scalable ETL/ELT patterns;
  • Experience with orchestration frameworks such as Apache Airflow.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: remote.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Parceiro de vendas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Parceiro de vendas em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Seja um Parceiro Estratégico do Grupo AG Tax Tech, a Primeira TaxTech do Brasil.


Você é um consultor, comercial ou líder de negócios com acesso a decisores C-level?

Quer oferecer aos seus clientes uma solução de alto impacto, sem custo inicial, e ainda gerar uma nova e significativa fonte de receita?

O Grupo AG Tax Tech, a primeira e maior TaxTech do Brasil, está expandindo sua rede de Parceiros Estratégicos. Já recuperamos mais de R$ 8 bilhões em tributos para mais de 12.000 clientes, incluindo 15% das empresas listadas na B3, e queremos que você faça parte desta história de sucesso.

Nossa missão é transformar a complexidade tributária brasileira em fluxo de caixa e compliance para as empresas, através de tecnologia proprietária e uma metodologia exclusiva. Para acelerar essa missão, buscamos parceiros que compartilhem da nossa visão e queiram crescer conosco.


Quem Buscamos? O Parceiro Ideal em 3 Dimensões:


1) Expertise e Acesso a Clientes Estratégicos:


Você é um especialista com reputação sólida em consultoria (contábil, tributária, RH), advocacia empresarial, tecnologia ou vendas; Possui um relacionamento de confiança com CFOs, CHROs e CEOs de médias e grandes empresas, especialmente as de Lucro Presumido ou Real? Buscamos sua credibilidade e seu acesso ao mercado.


2) Alinhamento com um Modelo de Negócio Inovador:


Você acredita em um modelo onde o cliente só paga pelo sucesso, sem custos de entrada ou taxas de manutenção?

Nosso modelo de remuneração 100% no êxito é um dos nossos maiores diferenciais. Buscamos parceiros que saibam comunicar o poder de uma proposta de valor de risco zero.


3) Mentalidade \"TaxTech\"


Você vê a tecnologia como o futuro da gestão fiscal? Com nossa plataforma proprietária Athena™, analisamos 100% dos dados fiscais sem amostragem, garantindo precisão e escala incomparáveis. Buscamos parceiros que queiram liderar a transformação digital no setor tributário.


O que Oferecemos à sua Parceria:


•Portfólio de Alto Valor: Adicione as soluções AG, AG Tax e Agnes ao seu portfólio e resolva dores latentes de seus clientes.

•Modelo de Receita Atrativo: Gere uma nova e robusta linha de receita, 100% comissionada sobre o sucesso das operações, sem limite de ganhos.

•Força da Marca Líder: Associe-se à marca que é referência no mercado, com metodologia validada, operação segurada pela Berkley e reconhecimento pela mídia e por grandes premiações (Exame, Deloitte, BTG Pactual).

•Diferencial Competitivo: Ofereça aos seus clientes uma solução inovadora que a concorrência não possui, fortalecendo seu próprio posicionamento como consultor estratégico.


Você se identifica com este perfil?


Se você é um profissional visionário, com uma carteira de clientes consolidada e o desejo de gerar um impacto financeiro real para seus clientes e para o seu negócio, queremos conversar com você.

Clique no link para saber mais e iniciar sua jornada como Parceiro Estratégico do Grupo AG Tax Tech.

description:

Sobre a vaga A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Um(a) profissional experiente em Microsoft Intune para atuar com clientes corporativos, apoiando a gestão moderna de dispositivos e aplicações em ambientes diversos (Windows, iOS, Android e macOS). O papel envolve arquitetura, implementação e evolução de soluções de endpoint management, segurança e identidade, com foco em ambientes híbridos e cloud, garantindo escalabilidade, compliance e excelência operacional.


Principais atuações:

  • Liderar estratégias de gerenciamento unificado de endpoints (UEM) utilizando Microsoft Intune e Configuration Manager (SCCM) .
  • Projetar, implementar e sustentar soluções de gerenciamento para múltiplas plataformas:
  • Windows (desktop e server)
  • Android (Enterprise – Work Profile, Fully Managed, Dedicated)
  • iOS / iPadOS
  • macOS
  • Planejar e executar cenários de co-gerenciamento (co-management) entre SCCM e Intune, incluindo workload transition.
  • Conduzir projetos de migração de ambientes legados (SCCM standalone, GPOs, MDMs de terceiros) para o Intune.



Requisitos necessários:

  • Inglês avançado para conversação.
  • Sólida experiência com Microsoft Intune em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.
  • Forte experiência com SCCM (Configuration Manager) :
  • Application Deployment
  • OSD (Task Sequences)
  • Software Updates / Patch Management
  • Experiência comprovada com Android, iOS/iPadOS e macOS no contexto de MDM/MAM.
  • Conhecimento avançado em co-management e ambientes híbridos .
  • Experiência com Microsoft Entra ID, Acesso Condicional e identidade híbrida .
  • Vivência com Autopilot, Autopatch e modernização de gerenciamento .
  • Experiência com empacotamento de aplicações (Win32, MSI, scripts) .
  • Forte capacidade de troubleshooting e análise de logs .
  • Experiência com automação (PowerShell / Graph API) .
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de certificados (PKI) .



Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) e Windows 365 .
  • Conhecimento em Zero Trust .
  • Certificações Microsoft (MD-102, MS-102, AZ-900, etc.).


**Vaga Híbrida - (90% H.O, 10% com possibilidades de viagens nível Brasil)

Contratação CLT

Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

Auxílio creche;

Convênio com Farmácia;

Cartão GoodCard;

Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

Gympass

Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. About the Role

Our client is a US-based performance marketing agency that builds and scales creative content for brands across paid social and digital channels. They are looking for a Creative Director to serve as the internal quality gate for all creative output — both video and graphics — before it reaches the client. This person will work closely with the agency's leadership team, taking ownership of creative review, direction, and strategy across active accounts.

  • Review and QA all video and graphic creative assets before client delivery, ensuring quality, brand alignment, and strategic clarity

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Creative Director, Senior Art Director, or equivalent role at a marketing agency or performance-focused creative team

  • Deep understanding of what makes creative perform on paid social channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Experience working with or managing designers and video editors
  • Excellent written and verbal English — able to communicate creative feedback clearly and professionally
  • Self-directed and highly detail-oriented — comfortable working async with a lean team
  • Familiarity with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, or similar) is a plus


Ideal Candidate

This role is for someone who has a natural eye for what's working and what isn't — and can articulate why with precision. They thrive in fast-moving agency environments where standards are high and feedback cycles are tight. They are equally comfortable directing a video edit and reviewing a static ad set, and they understand that creative strategy and execution are inseparable. They don't need to be reminded to raise the bar — they set it.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executive Assistant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Executive Assistant to a US CEO — Sales-Driven, Self-Starters Only

Read this whole thing before you apply. It's a filter.

We place Executive Assistants with US home-service business owners. You won't be a task-rabbit. You'll be the CEO's right hand — the person who moves the needle on whatever the business needs that week.


Your #1 job: make sure deals close. Appointment setting, direct sales, follow-up that doesn't quit. From there it widens — hiring providers, dispatching, customer satisfaction, finding new ways to grow the business. We're not hiring an assistant. We're hiring a mini-CEO who makes the big CEO's life bigger.


This role is for people who take the reins. Nobody is going to hand you a checklist every morning. You see the gap, you close the gap. If you need to be told what to do next, stop reading — this will frustrate both of us.


The pay grows when you do:

  • Start at $1,000/mo
  • Hit your first KPI → $1,250/mo
  • Hit the next → $1,400/mo
  • Performance bonuses from the business owner on top — up to $400/mo more

The ceiling moves because you move it. We don't cap people who produce.


What you need to have:

  • Fluent, clear, neutral English — easy for a US homeowner to understand on a call
  • Proven sales or appointment-setting background (show us the receipts)
  • Comfortable owning a number, not just doing tasks
  • Cold calling is a plus, not a must


The non-negotiables — apply only if these are a yes:

  • Available across all US time zones (PST/CST/MST/EST)
  • Up to 50 hours/week. This is firm.
  • Saturday mornings when the business needs it
  • Comfortable with Hubstaff time tracking. We use it for transparency, not to micromanage or punish — that's not how we operate. But it's part of the job.


If you read the hours and the ownership bar and felt more interested, not less — you're who we're looking for. Hit Easy Apply. If you're a fit, we'll come back to you fast — we move quick when we find the right person.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executive Assistant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Executive Assistant to a US CEO — Sales-Driven, Self-Starters Only

Read this whole thing before you apply. It's a filter.

We place Executive Assistants with US home-service business owners. You won't be a task-rabbit. You'll be the CEO's right hand — the person who moves the needle on whatever the business needs that week.


Your #1 job: make sure deals close. Appointment setting, direct sales, follow-up that doesn't quit. From there it widens — hiring providers, dispatching, customer satisfaction, finding new ways to grow the business. We're not hiring an assistant. We're hiring a mini-CEO who makes the big CEO's life bigger.


This role is for people who take the reins. Nobody is going to hand you a checklist every morning. You see the gap, you close the gap. If you need to be told what to do next, stop reading — this will frustrate both of us.


The pay grows when you do:

  • Start at $1,000/mo
  • Hit your first KPI → $1,250/mo
  • Hit the next → $1,400/mo
  • Performance bonuses from the business owner on top — up to $400/mo more

The ceiling moves because you move it. We don't cap people who produce.


What you need to have:

  • Fluent, clear, neutral English — easy for a US homeowner to understand on a call
  • Proven sales or appointment-setting background (show us the receipts)
  • Comfortable owning a number, not just doing tasks
  • Cold calling is a plus, not a must


The non-negotiables — apply only if these are a yes:

  • Available across all US time zones (PST/CST/MST/EST)
  • Up to 50 hours/week. This is firm.
  • Saturday mornings when the business needs it
  • Comfortable with Hubstaff time tracking. We use it for transparency, not to micromanage or punish — that's not how we operate. But it's part of the job.


If you read the hours and the ownership bar and felt more interested, not less — you're who we're looking for. Hit Easy Apply. If you're a fit, we'll come back to you fast — we move quick when we find the right person.

title: Coordenação de dados IA
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenação de dados IA em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Liderar o desenvolvimento e a implementação de soluções de inteligência artificial, garantindo a inovação e a excelência técnica.


Responsabilidades:


* Projetar, desenvolver e implementar arquiteturas e soluções de IA escaláveis e de alto desempenho.

* Liderar e mentorar uma equipe de dados, promovendo um ambiente de colaboração e aprendizado.

* Definir e aplicar as melhores práticas de engenharia de software e princípios de MLOps.

* Discutir a arquitetura geral de dados, incluindo armazenamento de dados, data lake, processos ETL/ELT e estruturas de governança de dados, considerando a escala ideal e o tempo de lançamento no mercado.

* Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para identificar oportunidades de aplicação de IA e traduzir requisitos de negócios em soluções técnicas.

* Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escalonáveis e confiáveis usando tecnologias apropriadas (por exemplo, Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka).

* Realizar pesquisa e avaliação de novas tecnologias e ferramentas de IA para impulsionar a inovação.

* Garantir a qualidade, segurança e conformidade das soluções de IA desenvolvidas.

* Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de modelos e sistemas de IA em produção.

* Participar ativamente da estratégia de tecnologia da empresa, representando a área de IA.

* Avaliar e recomendar novas tecnologias, processos e ferramentas para aprimorar e acelerar nossos componentes e capacidades de dados.

* Solucionar problemas e resolver problemas complexos relacionados a dados, otimizando o desempenho e a confiabilidade.

* Manter-se atualizado com as tendências do setor e os avanços em tecnologias e metodologias de dados.

* Contribuir para o planejamento estratégico de iniciativas de dados e roadmap de dados de longo prazo.


Qualificações:


* Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em ciência de dados, arquitetura de dados ou função semelhante com foco em dados, com pelo menos 2 anos em capacidade de liderança técnica.

* Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica e desenvolvimento de soluções de IA.

* Sólidos conhecimentos em machine learning, deep learning, processamento de linguagem natural (PNL) e visão computacional.

* Proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python e frameworks de IA (ex: TensorFlow, PyTorch).

* Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP), Databricks e ferramentas de MLOps.

* Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software.

* Capacidade de comunicação clara e eficaz, tanto em português quanto em inglês.

* Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Inteligência Artificial ou área correlata.

* Forte pensamento analítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas complexos.

title: Operations Support System Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Support System Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Company Description

Medicaidsoft is the first software platform specifically designed for managing long-term care Medicaid applications. Serving care facilities, Medicaid consultants, and elder law attorneys, the platform streamlines intake, eligibility assessment, document collection, and state form completion into a seamless workflow. Often compared to “TurboTax for Medicaid,” Medicaidsoft reduces administrative burdens, expedites approvals, and safeguards revenue by minimizing delays and errors. Founded by experienced Medicaid professionals, the company is dedicated to solving industry challenges and helping families receive faster approvals while enabling organizations to scale efficiently.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Operations Support System Engineer. The engineer will be responsible for troubleshooting system issues, maintaining and administering network operations, and providing technical support to customers and internal teams. Additional responsibilities include overseeing system administration activities and managing Network Management Systems (NMS) to ensure optimal performance and reliability. Collaboration across teams will be essential to maintain innovative and efficient technical solutions.

Qualifications
  • Proficiency in Troubleshooting and Technical Support to resolve system and network issues efficiently
  • Experience in Network Administration and Network Management Systems (NMS), including configuration and monitoring
  • Strong skills in System Administration, including maintenance, upgrades, and security implementations
  • Ability to work collaboratively and independently in a remote environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Familiarity with long-term care or healthcare systems is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Strategist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You’ll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.


Responsibilities

Creative Strategy

  • Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles
  • Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles
  • Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches
  • Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses
  • Help maintain creative standards to ensure consistent brand voice and persuasive quality across ads, landing pages, and funnels


Performance & Media Buying Integration

  • Use platform learnings and audience behavior to shape creative testing and copy direction.
  • Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads


AI & Creative Innovation

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).


Qualifications

  • Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting
  • Direct experience with women’s wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).
  • Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Working hours

  • 6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday)
  • Fully-remote


Compensation

  • $3,500 to $5,000/month


If you think you might be a good fit, please apply.

title: Engenheiro de dados S
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de dados S em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização.


A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud.

• Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake.

• Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes.

• Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento.

• Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure.

• Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados.

• Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas.

• Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias.

Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos

• Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções.

• Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis.

• Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados.

• Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua.

DevOps e Qualidade

• Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização.

• Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps.

• Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas.

• Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos).

• Experiência prática com Snowflake.

• Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures.

• Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud.

• Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps.

• Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados.

• Conhecimento de modelagem de dados

• Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub.

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).

• Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click.

• Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics.

• Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas.

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial.

• Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.

Confira esta oportunidade para Franqueado em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos procurando um Franqueado para integrar a equipe da BT AGRO BRASIL. Este cargo tem como principais responsabilidades a gestão e operação de uma franquia, incluindo o planejamento estratégico, controle financeiro e desenvolvimento de estratégias de vendas locais. O candidato também será responsável por estabelecer e manter relações sólidas com clientes e parceiros. Este é um cargo remoto e se dá em regime de contrato, oferecendo flexibilidade ao franqueado para gerenciar suas operações.


Remuneração:

  • Entre R$ 40.000,00 a R$ 100.000,00 mensal


*Valor pago por comissionamento de contratos fechados, resultado depende de performance.


Qualificações:

  • Gestão e Operação: Experiência em gerenciamento de negócios, controle de operações e planejamento estratégico.
  • Vendas e Relacionamento: Habilidade em vendas consultivas, negociação e construção de relacionamentos duradouros com clientes e parceiros.
  • Controle Financeiro: Conhecimentos em gerenciamento de orçamento, análise financeira e controle de custos para garantir a lucratividade da franquia.
  • Formação em Administração de Empresas, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas será um diferencial, assim como experiência prévia no setor agrícola ou de franquias.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma, com boa organização e habilidades de liderança serão altamente valorizadas.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Strategist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You’ll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.


Responsibilities

Creative Strategy

  • Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles
  • Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles
  • Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches
  • Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses
  • Help maintain creative standards to ensure consistent brand voice and persuasive quality across ads, landing pages, and funnels


Performance & Media Buying Integration

  • Use platform learnings and audience behavior to shape creative testing and copy direction.
  • Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads


AI & Creative Innovation

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).


Qualifications

  • Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting
  • Direct experience with women’s wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).
  • Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Working hours

  • 6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday)
  • Fully-remote


Compensation

  • $3,500 to $5,000/month


If you think you might be a good fit, please apply.

title: Desenvolvedor front-end SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor front-end SR em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Desenvolvedor(a) Front-end Sênior | React + Mobile Híbrido


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Front-end Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos de grande escala, com foco no desenvolvimento de experiências digitais modernas, performáticas e integradas aos ecossistemas mobile Android e iOS.


Buscamos profissionais que possuam sólida experiência em React e que tenham atuado em aplicações híbridas, compreendendo os desafios da integração entre aplicações web e componentes nativos mobile.


Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações Front-end utilizando React e TypeScript.

Construir interfaces modernas, escaláveis e com alta preocupação em performance e usabilidade.

Atuar na integração entre aplicações React e ambientes mobile por meio de WebViews.

Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes Android e iOS para implementação de funcionalidades e resolução de problemas de integração.

Participar de definições arquiteturais, revisões de código e disseminação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes, monitoramento e observabilidade.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor(a) Front-end Sênior.

Domínio de React, TypeScript e JavaScript moderno (ES6+).

Experiência com arquitetura de aplicações Front-end de grande porte.

Conhecimento em consumo e integração de APIs REST.

Vivência com testes automatizados e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Experiência com Git e metodologias ágeis.


Diferenciais Importantes

Experiência com aplicações híbridas utilizando WebView.

Conhecimento sobre comunicação entre JavaScript e código nativo.

Vivência com Android (Kotlin/Java) e iOS (Swift), especialmente em cenários de integração com aplicações web.

Conhecimento de Design Systems, bibliotecas de componentes corporativas e padrões de desenvolvimento em larga escala.

Experiência em instituições financeiras, fintechs, bancos digitais ou empresas com grande volume transacional.

Desejável conhecimento em ambientes financeiros.

title: Operations Support System Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Support System Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Company Description

Medicaidsoft is the first software platform specifically designed for managing long-term care Medicaid applications. Serving care facilities, Medicaid consultants, and elder law attorneys, the platform streamlines intake, eligibility assessment, document collection, and state form completion into a seamless workflow. Often compared to “TurboTax for Medicaid,” Medicaidsoft reduces administrative burdens, expedites approvals, and safeguards revenue by minimizing delays and errors. Founded by experienced Medicaid professionals, the company is dedicated to solving industry challenges and helping families receive faster approvals while enabling organizations to scale efficiently.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Operations Support System Engineer. The engineer will be responsible for troubleshooting system issues, maintaining and administering network operations, and providing technical support to customers and internal teams. Additional responsibilities include overseeing system administration activities and managing Network Management Systems (NMS) to ensure optimal performance and reliability. Collaboration across teams will be essential to maintain innovative and efficient technical solutions.

Qualifications
  • Proficiency in Troubleshooting and Technical Support to resolve system and network issues efficiently
  • Experience in Network Administration and Network Management Systems (NMS), including configuration and monitoring
  • Strong skills in System Administration, including maintenance, upgrades, and security implementations
  • Ability to work collaboratively and independently in a remote environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Familiarity with long-term care or healthcare systems is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred

A AI/R Everymind , fundada em novembro de 2014, é parceira oficial da Salesforce desde 2015 e especialista multicloud. Desenvolvemos soluções que transformam negócios de todos os portes e setores, unindo visão 360°, expertise tecnológica e uma mentalidade de inovação pioneira.


Somos parte da AI/R , a AI Revolution Company. Uma conexão estratégica de componentes revolucionários que incorporam a Inteligência Artificial por completo.


Você gosta de um desafio ? Junte-se a nós, venha ser um Everyminder!


#LI-LR2


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

• Atuar como Salesforce Developer com foco em soluções da indústria de Telecom utilizando Communications Cloud.

• Projetar, desenhar e implementar soluções técnicas escaláveis na plataforma Salesforce.

• Experiência com integrações (REST/SOAP APIs). Experiência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


Certificações

• Salesforce Platform Developer I (desejável)

• Salesforce Platform Developer II (diferencial)

• OmniStudio Developer Certification (diferencial)

• Certificações relacionadas a Communications Cloud (diferencial).


Informações adicionais:

Será considerado diferencial Certificações (uma ou mais):

• Experiência prévia em projetos de Telecom.

• Vivência com arquiteturas escaláveis em Salesforce.

• Conhecimento em DevOps Salesforce (SFDX, CI/CD).

• Experiência com performance tuning e governança da plataforma.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executive Assistant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Executive Assistant to a US CEO — Sales-Driven, Self-Starters Only

Read this whole thing before you apply. It's a filter.

We place Executive Assistants with US home-service business owners. You won't be a task-rabbit. You'll be the CEO's right hand — the person who moves the needle on whatever the business needs that week.


Your #1 job: make sure deals close. Appointment setting, direct sales, follow-up that doesn't quit. From there it widens — hiring providers, dispatching, customer satisfaction, finding new ways to grow the business. We're not hiring an assistant. We're hiring a mini-CEO who makes the big CEO's life bigger.


This role is for people who take the reins. Nobody is going to hand you a checklist every morning. You see the gap, you close the gap. If you need to be told what to do next, stop reading — this will frustrate both of us.


The pay grows when you do:

  • Start at $1,000/mo
  • Hit your first KPI → $1,250/mo
  • Hit the next → $1,400/mo
  • Performance bonuses from the business owner on top — up to $400/mo more

The ceiling moves because you move it. We don't cap people who produce.


What you need to have:

  • Fluent, clear, neutral English — easy for a US homeowner to understand on a call
  • Proven sales or appointment-setting background (show us the receipts)
  • Comfortable owning a number, not just doing tasks
  • Cold calling is a plus, not a must


The non-negotiables — apply only if these are a yes:

  • Available across all US time zones (PST/CST/MST/EST)
  • Up to 50 hours/week. This is firm.
  • Saturday mornings when the business needs it
  • Comfortable with Hubstaff time tracking. We use it for transparency, not to micromanage or punish — that's not how we operate. But it's part of the job.


If you read the hours and the ownership bar and felt more interested, not less — you're who we're looking for. Hit Easy Apply. If you're a fit, we'll come back to you fast — we move quick when we find the right person.

Cint is a global software leader in technology-enabled digital insights and research technology.
