title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Title: Senior Specialist, Global ICSR Case Processing & QC

Department: Global Patient Safety


Overview:

Seeking an experienced Senior Specialist in Global ICSR Case Processing & QC to independently manage the processing and quality control of individual case safety reports (ICSRs), ensuring regulatory compliance and excellence in data accuracy, completeness, and quality. The role includes SAE reconciliation, meeting compliance and productivity targets, and supporting onboarding and training for new team members.


Key Responsibilities:

  • ICSR Case Processing: Manage case processing and quality control of ICSRs from diverse sources (e.g., clinical trials, post-market, literature) to ensure timely, accurate submissions to regulatory authorities.
  • SAE Reconciliation: Perform SAE reconciliations between safety and clinical databases, track progress, resolve issues, and escalate when necessary.
  • Quality & Compliance: Adhere to KPI and quality metrics, ensuring productivity and process improvement within ICSR management.
  • Decision-Making: Execute decisions in line with operational policies, SOPs, and work instructions.
  • Vendor/CRO Coordination: Ensure ICSR activities align with PV agreements and contracts.
  • Training & Onboarding: Develop and update training materials, onboard new team members, provide feedback, and support the onboarding process.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, clinical medicine, nursing, pharmacy, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
  • Proficiency with Argus safety database and MS Office Suite.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in drug safety/pharmacovigilance or relevant clinical experience. Preferred 5-8 years of experience
  • Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA, MHRA) for pharmacovigilance reporting.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Global cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de Espanhol em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Acquisition Editor, Life Sciences
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Acquisition Editor, Life Sciences em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators, and students worldwide use JoVE for their research, teaching, and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including leaders such as Universidad de São Paulo, Universidade Estadual Paulista, Fundação Oswaldo Fiocruz and more. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India, servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We are seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as an Acquisition Editor. In this role, you will focus on recruiting new authors and content for our Journal.


Responsibilities:

  • Identify and recruit new authors, guiding them through the manuscript submission process for JoVE Journal.
  • Contact potential Guest Editors and collaborate with them to build a Methods Collections, our version of a special issue.
  • Establish and maintain a strong network of scientists/journal authors to drive content acquisition and grow submission rates.
  • Collaborate with the peer review team to facilitate the publication of manuscripts.
  • Meet or exceed monthly acquisition targets.


Requirements:

  • A Ph.D. in the Life Sciences.
  • Fluent English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven, with an ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with the publishing process is a plus.


Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation competitively placed within the local market, including unlimited bonus for manuscript acquisition.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and discovery.
  • Opportunity to work in a remote environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Vacation Rental Revenue Manager
description:

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio.


This is a fully remote position for candidates currently based in Brazil. You'll work with property performance data, market trends, and pricing tools to help us make smarter revenue decisions every week.

- Your resume

- A short note about your relevant experience

- Your LinkedIn profile, if available

title: Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.js + React + PHP
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.js + React + PHP em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos?

Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto (SP) que combate fraudes, desperdícios e inconsistências na saúde por meio da Carefy, uma plataforma de auditoria com inteligência artificial. Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds.

Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy:

  • Fazer acontecer: A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito. 
  • Jogar limpo: Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações.
  • Desafio move a gente: Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer.
  • Aprender rápido: Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade.
  • Cliente no centro: Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa.
  • 2 é maior que 1: Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho. 
  • Feito é melhor que perfeito: A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição.

Qual o desafio?

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados.

O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia?

A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes.

  • Desenvolvimento e Sustentação : Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Modernização e Migração : Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado.
  • Arquitetura e Banco de Dados : Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL).
  • Frontend : Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos).
  • Qualidade e Segurança : Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança.
  • Cloud e DevOps : Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos.

O que esperamos de você?

Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais:

  • Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica.
  • Flexibilidade e Adaptação: Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura.
  • Gestão de tempo e Autonomia: Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa.

Quais são os requisitos?

  • Experiência de 3+ anos em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência de 2+ anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção 
  • Experiência de 1+ anos com PHP em produção;
  • Experiência de 2+ anos com Tecnologias Web em produção;
  • Experiência de 2+ anos com Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL) , incluindo modelagem;
  • Experiência com filas e mensageria (RabbitMQ);
  • Conhecimento de frameworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.js;
  • Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura (Clean Architecture, SOLID);
  • Conhecimento sólido em Git e versionamento de código;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.

Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência em migração de sistemas monolíticos/legados para microsserviços;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Familiaridade com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2);
  • Conhecimento prático na integração de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) e no desenvolvimento de fluxos utilizando AI Agents.

O que oferecemos?

  • Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto (para candidatos de outras localidades);
  • Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
  • 6 dias de folga anuais + folga de aniversário;
  • Bônus de indicação;
  • Bônus de equipe;
  • Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VA e VR);
  • Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
  • Horários flexíveis;
  • Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde!

title: Business Development Representative (Remote)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Development Representative (Remote) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Oi! Na Bizneo somos uma das maiores plataformas de HR Tech da Europa e LATAM, com mais de 30 módulos de software para gestão de pessoas :) Estamos buscando reforços para o time comercial no Brasil: alguém que curta o jogo da prospecção, entenda rápido um produto complexo e saiba ter uma conversa de verdade com um gestor de RH — não só seguir um script.


O que você vai fazer aqui?


  • Prospectar e abordar empresas do mercado brasileiro por telefone, e-mail e LinkedIn, gerando oportunidades qualificadas para o time de vendas. Este é um papel de SDR/BDR puro: seu foco é abrir portas, não fechar contratos.
  • Entender o cenário de cada prospect: como gerenciam seus processos de RH hoje, quais são suas dores reais e onde a Bizneo pode fazer diferença.
  • Qualificar oportunidades com critério, não com volume. Nos interessa mais uma reunião boa do que dez reuniões fracas.
  • Manter o CRM atualizado e organizado. Dados limpos não são burocracia, são o que faz a máquina comercial funcionar.
  • Colaborar com o time de vendas e marketing para refinar mensagens, cadências e estratégias de abordagem com base no que você vê no campo.


O que buscamos?


  • Experiência prévia em prospecção, pré-vendas (SDR, BDR, Inside Sales) ou vendas internas em empresas de tecnologia ou SaaS. Pode ser pouca, mas tem que ser real.
  • Você é curioso/a sobre o produto que vende. Não quer só agendar reuniões — quer entender o que está vendendo e por que resolve o problema do cliente.
  • Comunicação clara e natural, tanto por escrito quanto por telefone. Sabe adaptar o tom ao interlocutor sem soar robótico.
  • Organização e disciplina no dia a dia: gerenciar pipeline, seguir cadências e cumprir follow-ups sem que ninguém precise cobrar.
  • Gosta de trabalhar com metas e se motiva com resultados, mas entende que consistência importa mais que picos.


Pontos extra se...


  • Já vendeu ou prospectou software de RH, gestão de pessoas ou SaaS B2B para o mercado mid-market.
  • Tem familiaridade com ferramentas como HubSpot, Salesforce ou plataformas de sales engagement (Apollo, Outreach, etc.).
  • Fala espanhol.


O que oferecemos?

  • Teletrabalho 100% — para sempre, de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
  • Jornada flexível de segunda a sexta.
  • Treinamento contínuo no produto e em técnicas de venda consultiva.
  • Possibilidades reais de crescimento: vários dos nossos AEs de hoje começaram como SDRs.

title: Business Operations Sr Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Operations Sr Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


Your Mission

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Customer Success Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our Customer Success strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with CS, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with CS and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy—including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.
  • Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth.
  • Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor CS productivity, NRR, Excel/Google Sheets as needed.
  • Translate business questions into analytical projects, delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency.
  • Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.


Requirements:

  • 3–4 years of experience in Customer Success Operations or Business Operations, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • Advanced spoken and written English skills.


Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth.
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil.


Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: Analista Financeiro Pleno
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Financeiro Pleno em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Analista de Financeiro Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time Financeiro e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de contas a pagar e receber, incluindo execução de pagamentos;
  • Realização de conciliações bancárias, garantindo a acuracidade das informações;
  • Atualização e controle do fluxo de caixa, assegurando o correto registro das movimentações financeiras;
  • Execução de rotinas financeiras recorrentes com alto volume de transações e prazos definidos;
  • Organização e arquivamento de documentos financeiros e fiscais;

  • Execução e suporte ativo no fechamento contábil, com envio de informações e realização de conciliações financeiras;
  • Execução de validações e suporte às auditorias financeiras;
  • Interface com áreas internas e fornecedores para resolução de pendências financeiras;
  • Identificação, análise e resolução de inconsistências financeiras, com proposição de melhorias;
  • Garantir a execução ponta a ponta das rotinas financeiras sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Garantir a qualidade, consistência e confiabilidade das informações financeiras.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida com rotinas financeiras e administrativas (conciliação, controle e análise de dados);
  • Conhecimento em relatórios financeiros e controles internos;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel/Google Sheets;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Power BI;
  • Boa comunicação, organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Perfil proativo, analítico, com boa gestão do tempo e trabalho em equipe.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com ERP financeiro (ex: Omie, Conta Azul, SAP, etc.);
  • Experiência construindo dashboards financeiros;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre tributos;
  • Vivência em empresas de alto crescimento ou startups;
  • Experiência prévia com processos de fechamento contábil e auditoria;
  • Experiência com melhoria contínua e otimização de processos financeiros.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software .NET
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Arquiteta de Software .NET em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


Missão:

Garantir a evolução contínua da arquitetura de TI da Dimensa, atuando de forma transversal nas BUs para padronizar tecnologias, impulsionar inovação e assegurar que os produtos atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, elasticidade, segurança, performance e time-to-market. O arquiteto será responsável por criar frameworks, acelerar a produtividade, viabilizar novos produtos voltados a Dados e IA, apoiar os times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura, promover a evolução tecnológica, apoiar a operação de sistemas críticos e representar a arquitetura nas frentes corporativas e junto aos clientes, alinhados à estratégia da arquitetura corporativa.


O Que Você Vai fazer (As Principais Entregas):

  • Apoiar as BUs com diretrizes arquiteturais, garantindo aderência e alinhamento estratégico
  • Atuar na construção e manutenção da nova plataforma de aceleração de sistemas
  • Pesquisar e avaliar novas tecnologias visando à evolução tecnológica dos produtos da empresa.
  • Elaborar e gerir documentos técnicos de decisão, como ADRs, RFCs e RFPs, para formalização de propostas e mudanças arquiteturais
  • Realizar governança técnica com foco em riscos, impactos e sustentabilidade das soluções
  • Propor melhorias e novos produtos com base em oportunidades tecnológicas, dados e IA
  • Representar a Arquitetura em fóruns corporativos e alinhar iniciativas estratégicas com as Business Units (BUs)
  • Definir processos relacionados à arquitetura corporativa e governança técnica
  • Atuar diretamente em crises de produtos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções relacionadas à performance, escalabilidade ou estabilidade
  • Conduzir due diligence técnica de novas soluções, tecnologias, fornecedores e M&A
  • Conduzir estudos e provas de conceito em soluções de IA, com foco em viabilidade e valor
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e seu impacto nos produtos e na estratégia da empresa


O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Arquiteto):

  • Arquitetura de Software moderna (microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, Domain-Driven Design, Dados e IA).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: .NET, Java, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Cloud & DevOps. Ex: AWS, Azure ou GCP; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD (GitLab/GitHub Actions).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tipo de banco de dados. Ex: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, além de NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), etc.
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Observabilidade & Resiliência: Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic Stack, OpenTelemetry, Circuit Breakers.
  • Ter capacidade de avaliar Segurança. Ex: OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, gestão de secrets, compliance (LGPD/PCI-DSS).
  • Ter capacidade de utilizar as Metodologias: SCRUM/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, SRE, FinOps básico.
  • Ferramentas de documentação: ADR tools, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io.


O Que Oferecemos:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.


This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.


Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

• +4 years of experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer;

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments;

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Java Software Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer (Java / AI-Enabled)

Rocket Financial builds innovative fintech products that improve how money moves globally. We work across multiple high-impact fintech projects , tackling complex problems in payments, infrastructure, and financial services.


We are a U.S.-based company hiring an international contractor located in Brazil . This role will work closely with a distributed team, including Brazil and Canada based engineers.


We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is primarily backend-focused but comfortable contributing to the frontend when needed. You’ll play a key role in shaping systems, building scalable applications, and leveraging AI tools to move faster and smarter.


WHY JOIN US

  • Fast-paced startup environment with high impact and real ownership
  • 100% fully remote role
  • Work with a U.S.-based company building cutting-edge fintech products
  • Flexible schedule with alignment to East Coast hours
  • Collaborative, international team with strong engineering talent
  • Opportunity to work with modern technologies and AI-driven development


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build and scale Java-based backend systems and microservices
  • Contribute to frontend features (React or similar) when needed
  • Design robust, scalable applications and system architectures
  • Use AI tools (Claude, Codex, etc.) to accelerate development and problem-solving
  • Write and refine effective AI prompts for engineering workflows
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Design to deliver impactful features
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and agile processes
  • Debug and resolve production issues and performance challenges


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience (strong backend focus in Java)
  • Experience with Spring, microservices, and REST APIs
  • Comfortable working across the stack (React/TypeScript or similar )
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude, Codex, etc.)
  • Strong system design and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Docker, CI/CD, and AWS
  • Able to thrive in a fast-moving environment and adapt quickly

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior (Node e React) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero

FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.


We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.


The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.


About the Role

This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS.

You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates.

You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.


What Success Looks Like

A successful engineer in this role:

  • Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems.
  • Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient.
  • Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence.
  • Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform.
  • Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities:


Full Stack Engineering

  • Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + TypeScript.
  • Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS.
  • Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.


AWS native Architecture

  • Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more.
  • Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized.


Systems Integration

  • Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools.

Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.


AI Forward Development

  • Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.

Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform.


Collaboration & Impact

  • Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs.
  • Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning.
  • Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.


What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture.
  • Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation.
  • Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend).
  • Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams.
  • High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work.
  • Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.


Why Freight Hero

  • Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech.
  • Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes.
  • Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales.
  • Competitive compensation with performance incentives.
  • Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: .NET Core Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para .NET Core Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

.NET Core Developer (Containerization & Application Support)

Remote

Contract


Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled and hands-on .NET Core Developer with strong experience in containerized application development and deployment. The ideal candidate will be responsible for enhancing existing .NET applications, supporting container-based deployments, and assisting internal teams with troubleshooting and optimization of containerized environments.

This role requires a strong development background combined with practical experience working with modern container technologies and cloud-native application practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain applications using .NET Core / ASP.NET Core
  • Develop and implement updates, enhancements, and bug fixes for existing .NET applications
  • Build, manage, and support containerized applications using Docker and related technologies
  • Assist internal teams with deployment, troubleshooting, and operational support for container-based applications
  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to application performance, container orchestration, and deployment pipelines
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including DevOps, Infrastructure, QA, and Product teams
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development best practices
  • Support CI/CD pipeline integration and deployment automation efforts
  • Monitor application stability, scalability, and reliability in containerized environments
  • Document technical designs, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting steps


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong experience in .NET Core / ASP.NET Core development
  • Proficiency in C# and modern backend development practices
  • Hands-on experience with container technologies such as Docker
  • Experience troubleshooting and supporting containerized applications in production environments
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms
  • Experience with REST APIs, microservices architecture, and distributed systems
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Knowledge of Git and version control best practices
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in cloud environments such as Azure or AWS
  • Exposure to AKS, EKS, or OpenShift environments
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools for containerized applications
  • Experience supporting enterprise application deployments
  • Understanding of infrastructure automation and scripting

title: Lab Systems Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lab Systems Architect em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success.



Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys.



Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.



THE ROLE

The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Learning Lab Architecture & Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments.
  • Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise.
  • Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership.
  • Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand.
  • Support LMS system integrations as required.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.


System Administration & Support

  • Allocate and reset user training accounts.
  • Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms.
  • Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience.
  • Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.


Reporting & Documentation

  • Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures.
  • Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL.
  • Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory.
  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred).
  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.



Be fully aligned to our core values:


  • Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
  • Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
  • Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
  • Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
  • Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion


At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Work Model:Remote

Location:Brazil / LATAM


Job Description • Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that directly contributes to company-wide initiatives • Develop using interesting technologies -- Elixir, Ruby, React, Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB • Have input into technical decisions that will shape the future of our software systems • Learn something new, whether it's a new software design pattern or a new initiative to push the company forward • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to your peers • Pair up with a team member to work together on features • Deploy user-facing code to production • Act as a strong partner to product and engineering management


Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

• 3-5+ years of software engineering experience

• Strong communication skills

• Understanding of reusable components/building component libraries

• Understanding of building production-ready web applications and systems

• Passionate about testing practices and continuous improvement

• Experience with any of Elixir, Erlang, Ruby, Javascript, NextJs, or another programming language • Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

• Bachelor of Computer Science degree or equivalent experience

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:

Company:


Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, and LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.


We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.


Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.


Our Team:


Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.

We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:

  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend


Role Requirements:


  • 4+ years of programming experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems
  • Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.)
  • Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments
  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact
  • Fluency in English is mandatory


How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.

• Accept a background check

• 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

title: Lab Systems Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lab Systems Architect em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success.



Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys.



Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.



THE ROLE

The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Learning Lab Architecture & Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments.
  • Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise.
  • Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership.
  • Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand.
  • Support LMS system integrations as required.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.


System Administration & Support

  • Allocate and reset user training accounts.
  • Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms.
  • Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience.
  • Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.


Reporting & Documentation

  • Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures.
  • Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL.
  • Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory.
  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred).
  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.



Be fully aligned to our core values:


  • Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
  • Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
  • Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
  • Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
  • Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion


At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote)

We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager

Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil


The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.


We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.

We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects across the Western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy.
